# Linden Park Office Relocation

**As of:** 9 October 2026  
**Overall status:** ✅ Green  
✅ Schedule · ✅ Budget · ✅ Scope · ✅ Risk

## Executive summary

Linden Park Office Relocation is on track with fit-out construction 72% complete and IT installation starting Monday. Schedule, budget, scope and risk are all within tolerance. Decisions needed: Confirm the staff move weekend and approve after-hours building access for movers.

## Status by dimension

| Dimension | Status | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Schedule | ✅ Green | No slips across 8 dated milestones. |
| Budget | ✅ Green | Forecast $652,000 vs plan $640,000 (+1.9%). |
| Scope | ✅ Green | All 1 scope change approved or rejected. |
| Risk | ✅ Green | 1 open item, none high-impact. |

## Accomplishments this period

- Lease signed
- Space design approved
- Fit-out construction 72% complete
- Huddle rooms scope change approved by steering committee

## Next steps

- IT network & AV install starts Monday
- Continue fit-out construction per schedule

## Top risks and issues

- **Vendor lead time is 6 weeks. Order placed 18 September with 2-week buffer.** (medium impact)  
  Owner: K. Osei · Mitigation: not stated

## Decisions and asks for leadership

- Confirm the staff move weekend and approve after-hours building access for movers
